2014_069_080514mtg.paragraph: Troy School District's Board of Education packet for the regular meeting of Tuesday, August 5, 2014 at the Administration Building, 4400 Livernois, combines the July 8, 2014 meeting minutes (Resolutions 14-076 through 14-086), the Treasurer's Reports for April and May 2014 with their full check registers, ACH, wire-transfer and P-Card listings, and the August agenda's personnel, curriculum and business items. Total disbursements in period were $4,776,047.23 for April 2014 and $6,082,064.88 for May 2014. The largest new business item is the $883,950.00 award for the Athens High School addition and remodeling, alongside $185,012.50 to VSC for SmartBoards and LED touch TVs from the 2014 Capital Projects Fund.

**Meeting**
Board of Education regular meeting agenda, Troy School District, 7:00 PM, Administration Building, 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098, August 5, 2014. Meetings cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) Mondays and Wednesdays at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m., streamed at vimeo.com/troyschools. Consent agenda: July 8, 2014 minutes; Treasurer's Report for April and May 2014; copy paper.

**July 8, 2014 minutes (Resolutions 14-076 to 14-086)**
President Philippart called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. with Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Schmidt and Underwood present, Superintendent Machesky, administrators Jolly, Miller, Rajter, Washington and Witt, and about 20 audience members. John Hanna of Sterling Heights addressed the Board on Schools of Choice. Actions: new hires Kelly Pasternak and Lauren Welch; a two-year probationary administrative contract without tenure for Remo Roncone as Troy High School Principal effective July 9, 2014; MHSAA membership for the district's six secondary schools from August 1, 2014 through July 31, 2015; renewal of the cooperative girls' gymnastics program with Avondale School District for 2014-15 and 2015-16; Chromebook hardware to CDWG, $51,240.00 (Miletti abstained, 6-0); food service equipment to Stafford-Smith, Inc., $77,780.00; iPad storage cabinets to CDWG, $55,775.00; secure entrance and theater work to Precision Contracting Group $144,500.00, Metro Electric Engineering Tech. $54,800.00 and Irwin Seating Company $130,048.00, total bid $329,348.00; auditorium stage equipment to Advanced Lighting & Sound, Inc., $425,492.38; iPad Airs from Apple Computers, $498,160.00. Adjourned 9:35 p.m.

Debt Service Funds show property taxes budgeted 16,145,934 against 15,789,630 actual, redemption of principal 8,660,000, interest on debt 3,324,912, and a fund balance moving from (2,938,785) to $923,037.

**August 5 action items**
Copy paper bid 9794 to Contract Paper Group, Inc., $99,540.00 (4,200 cases at $23.70). Probationary contracts for twelve teachers for 2014-2015. Kristie Young appointed Director of Technology effective August 11, 2014. Schools of Choice under Section 105c for 9th grade at the International Academy East for 2015-2016. SmartBoard Widescreen Interactive Whiteboard System award to VSC, $185,012.50. Athens High School additions and remodeling, $883,950.00. Food service equipment to Stafford-Smith, Inc., $90,140.00. MASB 2014 Delegate Assembly delegates certified: Paula Fleming, Todd Miletti, Nancy Philippart, Karl Schmidt. Report: bond projects update by Dr. Machesky.

**Agenda.** Troy School District Board of Education regular meeting, 7:00 PM, Administration Building, 4400 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098, 248.823.4000, August 5, 2014; meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) and streamed at http://vimeo.com/troyschools. **Minutes of July 8, 2014.** Held at the Services Building, called to order at 7:00 p.m. by President Philippart, with Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Schmidt and Underwood present, Superintendent Machesky, administrators Jolly, Miller, Rajter, Washington and Witt, and roughly 20 audience members. John Hanna, a Sterling Heights resident, addressed the Board about Schools of Choice. Resolution 14-076 (Hauff/Edmunds, 7-0) approved minutes of the June 3, June 10 special meeting, June 10 workshop and June 17, 2014 meetings. 14-077 (Miletti/Schmidt, 7-0) approved new hires Kelly Pasternak and Lauren Welch. 14-078 (Edmunds/Fleming, 7-0) gave Mr. Remo Roncone a two-year probationary administrative contract without tenure as Principal, Troy High School, effective July 9, 2014. 14-079 (Underwood/Miletti, 7-0) enrolled the six secondary schools under the Board in the Michigan High School Athletic Association, Inc., adopting its Constitution, By-Laws and current HANDBOOK, effective August 1, 2014 until July 31, 2015. 14-080 (Fleming/Underwood, 7-0) renewed the cooperative Girls' Gymnastics agreement with Avondale School District for 2014-15 and 2015-16. 14-081 (Schmidt/Edmunds) awarded Chromebook hardware to CDWG for $51,240.00 from the 2014 Capital Projects Fund, 6-0 with Mr. Miletti abstaining for conflict of interest for professional reasons. 14-082 (Miletti/Fleming, 7-0) awarded food service equipment to Stafford-Smith, Inc. for $77,780.00 from the 2014-2015 Food Services Fund. 14-083 (Fleming/Schmidt, 7-0) awarded iPad storage cabinets to CDWG for $55,775.00. 14-084 (Edmunds/Hauff, 7-0) awarded Precision Contracting Group general trades $144,500.00, Metro Electric Engineering Tech. electrical $54,800.00 and Irwin Seating Company fixed auditorium seating $130,048.00, total bid $329,348.00, for secure entrance renovation and theater upgrades. 14-085 (Hauff/Underwood, 7-0) awarded auditorium stage sound and lighting to Advanced Lighting & Sound, Inc. for $425,492.38. 14-086 (Underwood/Fleming, 7-0) approved iPad Airs from Apple Computers for $498,160.00. Dr. Machesky reported on his 90-Day Plan; adjourned 9:35 p.m., signed Karl D. Schmidt, Secretary.

**Personnel.** Probationary contracts for 2014-2015 are recommended for Kaitlin Bucchare (5th grade, Schroeder), Ross Burdette (1.0 FTE Social Studies, Boulan Park), Aguib Diop (1.0 FTE Psychologist, Services Building), Lauren Field (1.0 FTE Counselor, Larson), Johnathan McNurlen (1.0 FTE Elementary Vocal Music, TBD), Tanya Myre (1.0 FTE Elementary Visual Arts, TBD), Laura Rasmussen (1.0 FTE Orchestra, Baker), David Recker (1.0 FTE English, Troy High), Krystal Renton (1.0 FTE Humanities, Baker), David Russo (3rd grade, Leonard), Noelle Wald (1.0 FTE Biology, Troy High) and M. Kelsey Witt (1.0 FTE ESL, Troy High), each with a biographical sketch of degrees, Michigan certification and prior teaching posts. Ms. Kristie Young is recommended as Director of Technology on a two-year probationary administrative contract without tenure effective August 11, 2014, with nine years as Director of Technology at Fraser Public Schools and Lake Shore Public Schools, eleven years of corporate technology leadership, a 2005 B.S. in Management Information Sciences from Franklin University, and STM, PMP and Microsoft Innovative Educator/Trainer credentials.

**Curriculum and business.** The Schools of Choice resolution exercises the option under Section 105c of the State School Aid Act of 1979 as amended by Public Act 300 of 1996, accepting an unlimited number of 9th grade students from districts in another county whose intermediate school district is contiguous with Oakland Intermediate School District, for the International Academy East program in 2015-2016. The Smart Board bid goes to VSC for $185,012.50 from the 2014 Capital Projects Fund, covering 40 SmartBoards and 5 Sharp LED Touch TVs; VSC quotation 13814 dated 6/16/2014 (Novi, MI) prices the SMA-SBM685i6 system at 5,199.00 each less a 43% REMC 2014 Catalog Contract Discount, confirmed by Nancy Corner, Statewide $AVE Bid Project Director at Ingham Intermediate School District, whose contract ends December 31, 2014; a July 10, 2014 memo from Director of Technology Mark Washington recommends SmartBoards for elementary classrooms averaging 25 students or more. The Athens High School Addition and Remodeling award, bid package 9792 under the Bond Program Series 1, with proposals received July 23, 2014 and reviewed by Kenneth Miller with Ronald Curtis of Barton Malow and TMP Associates, goes to North American Construction Enterprises general trades $483,750.00, Contrast Mechanical $190,000.00, McNulty Electric $137,700.00 and Nagle Paving sitework $72,500.00, total $883,950.00 against a budget of $914,375, an underage of $30,425; the scope renovates the old shop area into Large Group Instruction and converts the photo studio into shared classroom space. Food Service Equipment and Installation, bid package 9795, goes to Stafford-Smith, Inc. for $90,140.00 from the 2014-2015 Food Services Fund, reviewed by Ken Miller, Purchasing Supervisor Todd Hensley and Sodexo Manager Gayle Moran, covering Solaris GCX-10-10-S steamers for Boulan Park and Larson, a Bakers Pride GDCO-E2 convection oven for Morse, Solaris EPX-5-S steamers for eight elementary schools and CresCor H-137-SUA-12D heated cabinets for Schroeder and Troy Union; the American Cook Systems bid was incomplete. Under Other, the Board certifies Paula Fleming, Todd Miletti, Nancy Philippart and Karl Schmidt as delegates to the Michigan Association of School Boards 2014 Delegate Assembly at the MASB Fall Conference, November 6-9, 2014, and Dr. Machesky is to report on bond projects, no action necessary.
